title: Concept: Insecure temporary file via tmpnam (c) — review required
description: In c, tmpnam names temporary files predictably or separates name choice from creation, opening a race window. The remedy is atomic exclusive creation via mkstemp.
applicability: c codebases creating temporary files through tmpnam; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local file overwrite or disclosure via symlink races; LOW severity, higher on multi-user systems.
